shopfront.alt: The shop’s lit window on a cobbled quay in the evening: shelves of books, an armchair under a reading lamp, a rowing boat moored alongside.

theLongShore.alt: The Long Shore on a reading table, its cover a lighthouse above a snowy, rocky shore, beside a bundle of letters tied with string.

saltAndInk.alt: Salt and Ink on a reading table, its cover an old map of a harbour with a compass rose, beside a dip pen and a bottle of ink.

smallBoats.alt: Small Boats on a reading table, its cover a red rowing boat on a bright blue sea, beside a little wooden toy boat.
